第50章 又见两只水獭，这下发财了-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“赵瞎子，这彩礼钱咱们是不是要商量商量？”赵贵望着眼前的赵瞎子，开口道。

“彩礼钱，你们打算要多少？”赵瞎子开口问道。

“这样吧，我们也不多要，五十块钱，怎么样？”赵贵伸出五根手指道。

“啥？”

“五十块钱？你们怎么不去抢？”

“谁家结婚要这么多彩礼？”

赵瞎子顿时被吓了一跳，瞪大了眼睛道。

“赵瞎子，你和别人能一样吗？”

“你可不要忘记了，你可是个瞎子，比我都大三岁，我家儿媳妇才二十来岁，还是个年轻的黄花大闺女嘞！”

“而且这个钱，还有一部分是给我家婆娘的。”

“你刚刚对我家婆娘干了什么，你不要忘记了。”

赵贵也瞪着眼睛道。

“不行不行，这也太贵了！”

“三十块钱，三十块钱最多了，这在咱们这，都已经不得了了，这可是我攒了几十年才攒下来的。”

赵瞎子眉头紧皱道。

“赵瞎子，干脆把你家这房子过户给我，然后再给十块钱的彩礼，你看怎么样？”

赵贵打量着赵瞎子的房子，开口问道。

赵瞎子的房子很小，院子也很小，也没盖什么厢房，房子也破，最多也就能卖个二十多块钱，但是自己一家子刚好没地方住，要是能搬进来，那就再好不过了。

剩下的十块钱，也能改善自己家的生活条件。

日子，也算是重新走上正轨了。

而且，还能让赵瞎子去和李青山拼个你死我活，岂不乐哉？

“这房子要是给你们了，我去哪里住？”赵瞎子明显不想这么干。

“要么，五十块钱1”

“要么，这房子外加十块钱，村头的那草房子归你，我们老两口和儿子就在那里住，反正你有婆娘，住在草房子里面，也比一个人住在这破地方好吧？”

“手里还有点闲钱，吃吃喝喝多好？”

“而且，你刚刚还对我家婆娘干了那种事情，你让让步，怎么了？”

赵贵商量道，赵贵的婆娘则是在后面低着头，心中不知道在想些什么。

“行！”

“只要有婆娘，住在哪里都无所谓。”

赵瞎子郑重的点了点头，旋即道：“你们儿媳妇王乃香呢，我得去见见我家婆娘！”

"Blind Zhao, do we need to discuss the gift money?" Zhao Gui looked at Blind Zhao in front of him and said.

"How much do you plan to ask for as a bride price?" Blind Zhao asked.

"Well, let's not ask for more. How about fifty yuan?" Zhao Gui said, holding out five fingers.

"What?"

"Fifty yuan? Why don't you go grab it?"

"Who wants so many colorful gifts for their wedding?"

Blind Zhao was immediately startled, his eyes widened and he said.

"Blind Zhao, are you the same as others?"

"Don't forget, you are a blind man, three years older than me. My daughter-in-law is only in her twenties, and she is still a young and beautiful girl!"

"And part of this money is for my mother-in-law."

"Don't forget what you just did to my mother-in-law."

Zhao Gui also stared and said.

"No, no, it's too expensive!"

"Thirty yuan, thirty yuan is the most. This is already a big deal here. It took me decades to save this."

Blind Zhao frowned.

"Blind Zhao, why don't you just transfer the ownership of your house to me and give me a gift of ten yuan? What do you think?"

Zhao Gui looked at Blind Zhao's house and asked.

Zhao Xiazi's house is very small, the yard is also very small, there are no side rooms, and the house is also dilapidated. It can only be sold for more than 20 yuan at most, but he and his family just don't have a place to live. It would be great if they could move in.

The remaining ten yuan can also improve the living conditions of my family.

Life can be considered to be back on track again.

Moreover, wouldn't it be fun to let Blind Man Zhao fight to the death with Li Qingshan?

"If this house is given to you, where will I live?" Blind Zhao obviously didn't want to do this.

"Either, fifty yuan 1"

"Or, for ten yuan more than this house, the thatched cottage at the end of the village can be yours, and we, the old couple and our son can live there. Anyway, you have a wife and living in a thatched cottage is better than living alone in this shabby place, right?"

"I still have some spare money, how about some food and drinks?"

"Besides, you just did that kind of thing to my mother-in-law, and you gave in. What's wrong?"

Zhao Gui discussed, while Zhao Gui's mother-in-law lowered her head behind, not knowing what she was thinking.

"Okay!"

"As long as you have a mother-in-law, it doesn't matter where you live."

Blind Zhao nodded solemnly and said immediately: "Where is your daughter-in-law Wang Naixiang? I have to go see my mother-in-law!"
